topic: What to say when your teen says 'I'm bored' (script included)
caption:
Next time your teen says 'I'm bored,' try this script.

Ask them: 'What if you could make $20 this week doing something you're already good at?' Then stop talking and listen.

That pause is where real confidence starts to grow.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
